_comment_secrets: No API key is stored here. `{env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY}` is resolved by
OpenCode at startup from the environment, which fits this machine's
per-project secrets model: keys live in Bitwarden Secrets Manager and are
NEVER globally exported. So OpenCode only sees a key when you launch it
from a repo with `setup-envrc` (direnv), or via a one-shot
Launching it from a directory with no .envrc and getting an auth error is
the supply-chain defense working, not a bug.
Do NOT run OpenCode's own `/connect` command: it writes the resolved key in
plaintext to ~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json, which is exactly the
global-key-on-disk situation this setup exists to avoid.
